sample_unit: patient educational materials on cirrhosis (4 chatbot-generated, 1 human-derived Epic) rated by 14 patients/caregivers and 8 hepatologists

links.outcome: Readability and grade level of cirrhosis education materials versus sixth-grade target
links.effect: Most materials, chatbot and human-derived (Epic), scored similarly in readability and grade level but were above the desired sixth-grade reading level.
links.quote: Most educational materials scored similarly in readability and grade level but were above the desired sixth-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Understandability and actionability of AI-generated patient education materials
links.effect: All materials were deemed understandable by both groups; only human-derived Epic material was considered actionable by both groups. No significant difference in understandability or actionability.
links.quote: All educational materials were deemed understandable by both groups, while only the human-derived educational material (Epic) was considered actionable by both groups.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of large language model-generated cirrhosis patient education materials versus standard human-written materials, evaluated offline by both clinicians and patients/caregivers.
